title: Add TTA to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [TTA](https://mahmoudtracy641-hub.github.io/GLM234) to video_audio
- Update: The app implements Pollinations' BYOP authorization flow (not classic PKCE): - Redirects to https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize with a public app key (pk_...) as client_id, a redirect_uri,

Fixes #15469

gist.headline: TTA joins the garden
gist.blurb: TTA has landed in video_audio, bringing another little creative machine to the patch. It uses Pollinations’ BYOP authorization flow, so the keys stay where they belong: with the gardener.
gist.summary: Added the TTA app to video_audio and registered its Pollinations BYOP authorization flow, which redirects public-app-key users through enter.pollinations.ai/authorize with a redirect URI.
gist.impact: People can now use TTA through video_audio with Pollinations authorization handled by the BYOP flow rather than requiring a classic PKCE setup.
gist.visual_concept: Depict TTA as a cozy creative audio-and-video workstation: a retro CRT editing screen with gentle waveform and film-strip pixels, connected to a small authorization key and a winding garden path. Polli wears tiny headphones and helps guide the public app key into the glowing terminal, while code-plants and flowers make the authorization handoff feel welcoming rather than bureaucratic.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art video-and-audio garden studio where Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny headphones while guiding a little key toward a retro CRT terminal showing simple pixel text “TTA”; film strips, soft sound waves, flowers, and code-plants surround the workstation. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
